name: CompletedMatch
epl: @Name('CompletedMatch') select a as firstEvent, b as secondEvent from pattern [every a=Event(status='observed') -> b=Event(status='observed')]

name: TimeoutMatch
epl: @Name('TimeoutMatch') select a as firstEvent, b as secondEvent from pattern [every a=Event(status='observed') -> (b=Event(status='observed') or timer:interval(5 sec))]
